questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Two-thirds of the work ____ completed.”
questions.why: The verb agrees with the noun after 'of' (work, uncountable, singular). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Don’t forget ____ the register before you leave.”
questions.why: 'Forget' + infinitive refers to a duty not yet done. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “He tried to ____ his negligence as bad luck.”
questions.why: 'Pass off as' means to represent falsely as something else. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “He is the only one of the students who ____ passed.”
questions.why: With 'the only one of', 'who' refers to 'one', so the verb is singular. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Were I in your position, I will accept the offer.
If I am in your position, I would accept the offer.
Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
Was I in your position, I would accept the offer.
questions.why: 'Were I …' is the inverted form of 'If I were …', followed by 'would'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “perfunctory”:
questions.why: 'Perfunctory' means done with minimal effort; cursory. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful paragraph:
P. However, excessive use disturbs sleep and attention.
Q. Smartphones have made communication quick and convenient.
R. Doctors therefore advise limiting screen time at night.
S. Many people now depend on them for work and study.
questions.why: Benefits first, 'However' introduces the drawback, 'therefore' the advice. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “The students were told to ____ before the examination.”
questions.why: 'Buckle down' means to start working seriously. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “Everyone has submitted the form, ____?”
questions.why: 'Everyone' takes the plural pronoun 'they' in a tag. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “inexorable”:
questions.why: 'Inexorable' means impossible to stop or persuade; relentless. GPSC-style practice item.
